instruction: Switch my browser's default search provider to Ecosia.

metadata.explanation: Task requires configuring Chrome to use Ecosia as the default search engine. Uses existing getter get_default_search_engine and metric match_in_list to verify the configuration.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic correctly extracts default search engine from Chrome Preferences file (default_search_provider_data.template_url_data.short_name)
Metric logic correctly verifies if result matches expected value using match_in_list (checks if 'Ecosia' in result)
Expected value is semantically correct: ['Ecosia'] matches what the instruction requires
Postconfig appropriately restarts Chrome to ensure settings are persisted to Preferences file before verification
Complete coverage: evaluator verifies the only requirement - that default search engine is Ecosia
Data flow is correct: getter returns string (search engine name) -> metric compares with expected list ['Ecosia']
